**Ordering addendum.** This card may land after #28117. But the switch must not become **customer-visible** until the HotCRM-lane card that makes the app package tolerate a disabled module has landed. Today, disabling `…hotcrm.service` would make saving a task or event fail in the app's own hooks (see the addendum on #28117). That HotCRM card is filed once the maintainer agrees; its number is added here as a `Blocked-by:` line when it exists. Until then: build and test behind the server verdict, and do not ship it to customers.

Item 1 reads "the served verdict #28117 adds next to `writable`". #28117's PR #28308 does not add it: card item 4 routed the new key to the spec lane as a Seam. It is filed as #28318. So this card waits on both:

Blocked-by: #28117
Blocked-by: #28318

When PR #28308 lands, the server accepts a module disable. The Packages page still cannot offer it until #28318 serves the verdict, because `writable` stays `false` for a module. The ordering addendum `6523692915` (HotCRM tolerance before the switch becomes customer-visible) is unchanged.

Doc rider for this card. ⛔ Not a claim.

PR #28371 (#28318) serves `disableable` beside `writable` on `GET /packages` and `GET /packages/:id`. Its PR body's `Skills-docs:` line names this card as the follow-up for one doc edit. When the Console reads the key, the same PR updates the "Disabling a module" section of `content/docs/deployment/marketplace-handbook.mdx` to name the key, so the handbook says what the Packages page now offers. No `skills/**` page names the package verdicts, so no skill edit is owed.
